title: Chapter 333 The Second Tip
content:
Chapter 333 The Second Tip

——"Giant Dragon Army Summoning Scroll".

Wang Shuo was shocked. How powerful would the summoned dragon army be?

Could it be that they were all level 100 dragon knights?

He couldn't help but imagine.

The second one was a defensive item called "Four-sided City".

The exchanged military merit points required 30 million.

It was obvious that it was a city defense item, probably something similar to the light curtain above Shanhai City.

But Wang Shuo still couldn't afford it.

Then he browsed down and found that a booklet "Outline of the Shenwu Empire" actually required 10 million military merit points.

Wang Shuo was shocked.

But it also attracted Wang Shuo's attention.

The properties of items that could not be exchanged could not be viewed. After Wang Shuo clicked on the introduction of this booklet, the expression on his face gradually became exciting.

After reading it, he checked other items.

Including some equipment production drawings, some powerful disposable items, and some skills and techniques.

Wang Shuo thought about it and exchanged the booklet.

The reason was that it said that the empire in the north of the Great Huai Territory was the Shenwu Empire.

Just this sentence made Wang Shuo's heart move.

After the exchange, just when Wang Shuo wanted to take out the "Shenwu Empire Outline" to take a look, he noticed that the brocade bag given to him by Lord Zak had reacted.

Wang Shuo frowned.

This was the second brocade bag. After opening it, a piece of animal skin paper inside said.

"In three months, the Great Wall of Steel will be opened."

Wang Shuo was a little confused.

The Great Wall of Steel?

Wang Shuo had never heard of the Great Wall of Steel, and he was a little puzzled for a while.

But it was obvious.

This news was extraordinary.

It seems that he needs to investigate it carefully.

Wang Shuo thought for a while, and then exchanged a few other items that he liked.

At this time, Zhao Bangde's voice sounded.

"Please come to the Lord's Mansion for a chat with all the lords and mayors."

After Wang Shuo arranged his army, he led a group of lords and mayors from Changping County to the Lord's Mansion.

Everyone smiled, and it was time to reward them according to their merits.

"Everyone, thank you for coming to support Shanhai City. All the energy crystals and soul crystals will be counted later, and then distributed to everyone according to the military merit ranking. As for the materials you have picked up, they will not be counted."

Zhao Bangde's move immediately won the favor of everyone.

Wang Shuo thought about it for a while. Zhao Bangde successfully saved Shanhai City, and he was the first on the military merit list. Naturally, there were benefits.

Things like these energy crystals are very good, but the benefits he got are definitely not something that can be exchanged for money.

Then, Zhao Bangde said: "Although we barely managed to hold Shanhai City, the other two county cities are still fighting."

"As fellow tribesmen, we should help each other. If the human race in Dahuai Territory suffers too much loss, we may have little chance of surviving in the next game."

"So, we should unite and fight against the undead together until they are completely eliminated."

"Mr. County Magistrate, well said. As fellow human races, we should be united and fight against the undead. It is a great cause, and I support it."

"I support it too..."

...

Everyone responded immediately.

If someone raised an objection at this time, it would definitely be a brain problem.

It would inevitably lead to isolation and contempt from others.

They would be regarded as scum of the human race.

"Okay, in that case, let's set off as soon as possible. We will gather and set off in three hours."

After everyone went down.

Wang Shuo found Zhao Bangde and asked about the Great Wall of Steel.
